newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit Conrowa ends debut higher.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit Conrowa ends debut higher.

text.p: Shares of Leading Spirit Conrowa Electric Co Ltd ended above their issue price on their first day of trade on Thursday, but their failure to sustain at higher levels disappointed investors, brokers said.
The shares ended at HK$1.39 per share, up HK$0.39 or 39 percent from their issue price of HK$1.00 each.
"It was a bit disappointing as they (the shares) failed to sustain at a higher price in view of their high grey market price," said Michael Ng, analyst at ASG Capital.
Analysts said the grey market of the stock once hit a high of about HK$2.00 last week.
The company's shares moved within a range from HK$1.20 to HK$1.49 on Thursday. Volume was 248 million shares worth HK$353.41 million.

Analysts said the recent weak performances of new listings and relatively strong profit-taking interest ahead of the five day weekend to mark Hong Kong's handover to China dampened the stock's upside.

Leading Spirit Conrowa, a unit of Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd, issued 393.12 million shares in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong. Its public offer of 275.18 million shares was 112.57 times subscribed.
The preferential offering portions to the company's employee and its parent's existing shareholder were fully allotted.
However, some analysts said they saw an upside potential for the stock in the long run benefitting from a pick up in China's retail market.

The home appliance maker said it would use the net proceeds to expand production capacity and to set up special shops and outlets in China. It currently has a distribution network of more than 330 speicalty shops in China.
